name: Screenshot to Bug Reporter AI Agent (Groq + Jira) - Auto Create

parameters.formDescription: Upload a screenshot. Groq will analyze it and the workflow will create a Jira issue for every submission, including items flagged for manual review.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: 'qwen/qwen3.8-27b', temperature: 0.1, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a careful QA engineer analyzing screenshots. Return only valid JSON. Do not invent root causes, steps, expected behavior, or environment details. Separate observations from assumptions. If evidence is insufficient, set isPotentialBug=false and requiresManualReview=true. Never include secrets visible in the screenshot.' }, { role: 'user', content: [ { type: 'text', text: 'Analyze the attached application screenshot and supplied context. Generate a Jira-ready bug report with fields: isPotentialBug (boolean), confidence (0-1), summary, description, stepsToReproduce (array), expectedResult, actualResult, severity (Blocker/Critical/Major/Minor/Trivial/Unknown), priority (Highest/High/Medium/Low/Lowest/Unknown), environment, component, evidence (array), assumptions (array), missingInformation (array), recommendedLabels (array), requiresManualReview (boolean). Do not fabricate information. Context: ' + JSON.stringify({ applicationFeature: $json.applicationFeature || 'Not provided', environment: $json.environment || 'Unknown', stepsToReproduce: $json.stepsToReproduce || 'Not provided', expectedBehavior: $json.expectedBehavior || 'Not provided', actualBehavior: $json.actualBehavior || 'Not provided' }) }, { type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: 'data:' + $json._firstImage.mimeType + ';base64,' + $json._firstImage.imageBase64 } } ] } ] } }}

nodes.name: Analyze Screenshot with Groq
nodes.notes: Uses existing Groq account credential. Model set to qwen/qwen3.8-27b; confirm it is enabled for your Groq account. This model supports image input according to current Groq documentation.

nodes.name: Create Jira Bug
nodes.notes: Select the existing n8n credential named 'Jira SW Cloud account'. Do not create a new credential. If import does not resolve it automatically, open this node and select the existing credential. Creates a Jira issue for every screenshot submission. Reports flagged for uncertainty receive the review-required label. Replace YOUR-DOMAIN and YOUR_PROJECT_KEY, and select your Jira Cloud credential. Response error handling uses standard HTTP Request behavior; inspect the node's response body if Jira returns an API error.

nodes.name: Attach Screenshot to Jira
nodes.notes: Select the existing n8n credential named 'Jira SW Cloud account'. Do not create a new credential. If import does not resolve it automatically, open this node and select the existing credential. Replace YOUR-DOMAIN in the URL expression. Select your Jira Cloud credential. The original uploaded screenshot should be attached as binary property screenshot.
